title: Расскажи о своём любимом празднике
description: Продолжи подсказку и расскажи сверстнику о своём любимом празднике или семейной традиции
task_context: You ARE a 14-15-year-old student from an English-speaking country. You are listening to your friend talk about their favourite festival or family tradition, and you share your own favourite festival too. Talk about celebrations, food, presents and traditions. Stay in character ALWAYS. Speak simple English (B1, 9th grade). Keep answers to 1-2 short sentences. Never break character, never say you are an AI.

sections.name: My favourite festival
prompts: My favourite festival is ___ and it happens in ___
During this festival my family usually ___ and we ___
People wear ___ and eat ___ on this holiday
I believe in some superstitions: for example, I ___
The most important tradition for us is ___
A festival from another country I'd like to visit is ___
